models: retained best of 100 PPO with 2 fixed V1 seats
selection: argmax candidate-plan probability under the frozen policy; no retraining
candidate_constraints: renormalize native legal action logits over continuations of public candidate plans; shared forced actions have probability one
positioning: canonical left-to-right move sequence followed by EndTurn for each public arrangement
ordering: execute each listed sequence, resolving shifted cards by entity ID
targeting: execute the question's required action, then score its target choices
purchase: listed buy-and-immediately-play sequences followed by EndTurn, including buying nothing
hero_selection: restore the public offered heroes as a pending HeroSelect, matching the scripted adapter
natural_decisions: use the actual saved seat and public action-to-answer map
observation_boundary: only Game.observe(seat) and the true legal mask enter the network
blocked_tasks: saved states whose pending choices block all listed plans are unmappable and remain zero in the denominator; never clear pending state to make actions legal
candidate_execution: recruit actions on independent reseeded copies only; no combat search or value-head lookahead
rules: no rule-QA head; retain all unsupported items, count zero in official denominator
combat: pure policy unsupported; separate augmented system uses the unchanged scripted baseline's 256-simulation combat component
aggregation: unchanged official scorer; Play is the unweighted mean of 30 play-scenario accuracies
leakage_control: inference denies label-file reads; seal prediction hashes before opening labels or reference answers
precision: both policies BF16 neural forwards; FP32 weights, head outputs and candidate probabilities
comparison_scope: a local task adapter, not a reproduction of the original TavernAgent benchmark interface
comparison: V1 source vs V2 retained best; identical label-free adapter and official scoring
